thread:
maya: Quick design review — API key create / rotate / revoke flows. Main focuses: warning iconography, CTA ordering, progressive disclosure, and a11y. Ping @anil @tess for copy + a11y input.

anil: Fast note — love progressive disclosure but worried about CTA order when users lack rotation perms. If "Create" is primary and they later can't rotate, we should surface that up front.

tess: Accessibility: when the secret is generated we need an aria-live region that announces "New API key generated" and then a visible "Download key". Also make the download link text explicit (e.g., "Download key (will not be shown again)").

sam: Flow idea: Revoke should be 2-step for org-level keys (confirm modal with checkbox). For user-level keys keep a 10s undo snackbar so we don't block quick recovery.

kevin: Iconography nit — current :warning: feels too alarmist for permission hints. Suggest :shield: or a smaller inline info icon for scope/permission notes, reserve red :warning: for destructive irreversible actions.

maya: Agree on smaller inline icon + help link. Also propose showing scope (Org / Project / Team) on the create modal below the name field so users understand the blast radius before they create.

anil: UX nit: after creating a key keyboard focus should land on the "Show secret" / "Download" affordance, not back on the modal close button. We need a11y test for focus order.

tess: Copy tweak suggestion: change "Download key now — this is the only time you'll see it" to "Download now — you'll only be able to view this key once." slightly simpler and active voice.

sam: Edge case: empty state when user has no create permission. Instead of showing disabled create button, show a "Request access" CTA that opens the permission request flow with pre-filled context.

maya: I'll mock variants: (1) normal create modal, (2) create modal with permission warning + inline help, (3) empty state with request access CTA. Will add a11y annotations.

designbot: Checklist added to the Figma file: focus order, aria-live for secret, meaningful link text, contrast checks for icons, keyboard-only interaction test. Ref: figma.com/file/xyz (internal).

kevin: Ops asked if we can surface "rotation history" in key details (audit trail + last rotated by). Might be a small backend ticket but useful for trust.

anil: Good call. Let's log a follow-up: add rotate history + last-rotation timestamp to key detail, and keep the UI changes as atomic (icon + CTA order + copy) for this sprint.

maya: :thumbsup: I'll update the Figma and push a cleaned mock into #design-review tomorrow morning, with copy variants for devdocs. Thanks everyone — will include the new accessible wording and the undo snackbar proposal.

kevin: small final: for revoke confirm modal, include a short reversible hint: "You can undo for 10 seconds" when applicable, so users understand safety net.

maya: noted. will include the 10s undo state in the prototype and the permission-aware CTA states.
